column3: BootUI provides update, ci and docs commands; sharpit omits update (no self-updating network binary), ci (orchestration beyond single-query CLI scope) and docs (no offline JVM documentation server).
BootUI checks remote registry for updates on CLI invocations; sharpit performs no update check to prevent unexpected outbound network traffic during local tool invocations (AGENTS.md safety rule 6).
Python standard library argparse replaces JVM picocli to satisfy standard-library-only rule for the CLI package (AGENTS.md architecture rules 2 and 4).

--token CLI option is supported and takes precedence over SHARPIT_TOKEN, but SHARPIT_TOKEN is recommended in documentation because command-line arguments are visible in host process listings to other users.
